verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own public APIs. An Admin API can create custom commands, and a Python Cloud SDK wraps the query and ingestion APIs. Its docs say the APIs and SDKs let you programmatically ingest data and configure devices. However, the evidence covers only a few API areas, and the probe found no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, so full end-to-end programmatic control is not shown. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths all 404), a documented endpoint reference covering the whole product (fleet orchestration, teleop, analytics), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
